items.label: Womens Purse size
items.value: 9.5"LX10.5"WX11.5"H,(25Lx27Wx30H cm).The height of the handbag is approximately equal to the longest side of an A4 paper.The height of the hand strap is 9.8"(25cm).The height of the shoulder strap is 13.38inches(34cm).Weight is about 2.31LBS(1.05KG)

items.label: Multipurpose Shoulder Bag
items.value: The golden accessroies can well highlight its personality design,which can be used in any occasions.The magnetic buckle with strong suction force are used to well close the bag. There is a detachable zipper pocket inside to store cellphone,purse,makeup etc.The fixed small side zipper pocket can be used to put some small items,such as coins,keys,lipstick etc.The detachable two hand straps along with one shoulder strp are very convenient to use.

items.label: Unique Designer Crossbody Bag
items.value: The material of this guitar strap purses crossbody is soft and comfortable,foldable and not deformed, and has a storage function,It can be folded and placed in your totebag or backpack,It is very lightweight,saves space, and allows you to go when you travel.At the same time, it adopts the wide shoulder strap design reduces the burden of walk, and does not feel the weight of the messenger bag,which is very lightweight.
